bankConnection.title: Bank connection
bankConnection.intro: Fetch owners' payments straight from the community's bank account — at any Slovak or Czech bank.
bankConnection.guideTitle: How to set up Enable Banking
bankConnection.guideIntro: Enable Banking is a licensed payment institution (PSD2) that gives the app read-only access to account transactions. Setup takes about 15 minutes and is done by whoever runs the server.
bankConnection.step_account_body: Open the Enable Banking control panel and sign in with your e-mail — they send you a sign-in link. The account is created by whoever runs the community's server.
bankConnection.openControlPanel: Open the Enable Banking control panel
bankConnection.step_app_body: In the API applications section add a new application: environment Production, name e.g. after your community. Add exactly this address to the allowed redirect URLs:
bankConnection.redirectUrlMissing: The app's public address is missing. Set NEXTAUTH_URL (e.g. https://hoa.example.com), restart the app and come back here.
bankConnection.step_key_body: The control panel can generate the key right in the browser — you download the private key (.pem). Or create it yourself with this command and upload the .crt file to the control panel. Never send the private key to anyone. After registering you see the application ID.
bankConnection.step_env_title: Put the values on the server
bankConnection.step_env_body: Set the application ID and the private key as environment variables (docker-compose or .env) and restart the app. For security, the key is not entered through the web interface.
bankConnection.envOrInline: or the key inline, lines separated by \n:
bankConnection.step_link_title: Link the community's account in Enable Banking
bankConnection.step_link_body: On the application in the control panel choose Link accounts, pick the community's bank and sign in. This activates the application in restricted mode: free, but it only sees accounts linked this way.
bankConnection.step_connect_body: After the restart a bank picker appears on this page. Choose the same bank, sign in and approve access. Then fetch payments with Sync now on the Payments page.
bankConnection.guideCost: Restricted mode is free for your own accounts. If you run the app for several communities you need a paid contract with Enable Banking. The cloud version has this set up for you.

claude: Open Claude (web or desktop) and go to settings (e.g. Settings or Customize).
Find Connectors and choose to add a custom connector (e.g. "Add custom connector").
Paste the address above and confirm (e.g. "Add").
Sign in to this app and approve access.
In a new chat, turn the connector on via "+" and then Connectors.
guide.claudeNote: On Team and Enterprise plans an admin adds connectors in organization settings. The free plan allows one custom connector.
chatgpt: In ChatGPT open settings and find Apps & Connectors (may also be called Plugins).
Add a custom MCP server or connector. On some plans you first need to turn on "Developer mode" in advanced settings.
Name it, paste the address above and choose OAuth as the sign-in method.
Sign in to this app and approve access.
In a new chat, pick it from the "+" menu.
guide.chatgptNote: Menu names differ by version and plan. If you do not see the option, your ChatGPT plan may not support custom connectors.
other: Use any AI app that supports remote MCP servers with OAuth sign-in.
In the app settings find the option to add a custom connector or MCP server and paste the address above.
Sign in to this app and approve access.
safety: The AI sees only what you see in the app.
Changes are made only after you click confirm.
Votes are confirmed by e-mail or in the app.
Disconnecting below removes the AI's access immediately.
